description: This file defines the MenuTreeParameters class in the Drupal core, modeling parameters for building menu trees, including root, depth, parent restrictions, active trail, and conditions.

classes.name: MenuTreeParameters
classes.description: A value object class for configuring menu tree loading parameters in Drupal.

methods.name: setRoot
methods.description: Sets the root menu link plugin ID for the menu tree.

methods.name: setMinDepth
methods.description: Sets the minimum depth of menu links to include.

methods.name: setMaxDepth
methods.description: Sets the maximum depth of menu links to include.

methods.name: addExpandedParents
methods.description: Adds parent link IDs to restrict the tree to certain branches.

methods.name: setActiveTrail
methods.description: Sets the active trail of menu link plugin IDs.

methods.name: addCondition
methods.description: Adds custom query conditions for filtering links.

methods.name: setTopLevelOnly
methods.description: Limits the tree to only the top level.

methods.name: excludeRoot
methods.description: Excludes the root link from the tree.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Unserializes the object from cache data.

methods.name: __unserialize
methods.description: Restores object data from serialized form.
